estimate.message: Save your marketplace selling costs to see what you would keep at this price.

limitations: Sell Watch shows context for cards you own. It gives no instruction about what to do with a card.
Selling costs are the ones you enter. FlipForge does not supply or assume your fees.
An estimate uses the price you type in. It is not a valuation, an offer or a market value, and taxes are not included.
Recent-sales comparisons are not shown: FlipForge has no licensed source of completed-sale records active.
Sell Watch never rescores, reranks or changes a saved FlipForge decision, and authorizes no transaction.
